name: Focused Death Attack, Greater
body:
Your death attack is even harder to resist.

Prerequisite(s): Focused Death Attack, assassin 4th.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional +2 bonus to the DC of your death attack. This stacks with the bonus from Focused Death Attack.
